deliberate_oversampling: Every paired-discrimination item is force-included even where that skews tier proportions away from 6/6/6/6. Those pairs are the only reflex-immune metric in the suite -- each half looks like the other and requires the opposite response -- so an ablation blind to them loses its most interesting comparison. The skew is recorded here rather than hidden: read per-tier ablation numbers as covering these questions, not a uniform sample of the tier.
